content:
dave_cust: Hey team — after the rollout this morning our integration stopped receiving plugin triggers. Previously every time the model returned an action it hit our /order-service webhook. Now it returns text but never calls the tool. Customer reports started ~09:10 UTC.
alice_support: Sorry you're hitting this, can you paste a minimal repro request and the model id + rollout id? Also which environment (prod/qa)? :eyes:
dave_cust: Prod. Sample request we send:```json
{
  "session": "s-6789",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "cancel order 12345"}],
  "tools": [{"name": "order_cancel", "schema": {"type": "object"}, "preferred": true}]
}```

dave_cust: Response used to include a function call object: `{"name": "order_cancel", "args": {"order_id": "12345"}}` but now we only get text reply: "I can help cancel that. What is the order ID?"
alice_support: Thanks. Did the customer change the prompt or routing? Any proxy in front of us that might strip fields?
dave_cust: No changes on our side. We saw the rollout at 08:55 UTC (canary -> 100% at 09:00).
bob_eng: I can take a look. Can you share the exact response headers and the full response body (raw)? If possible a HAR or cURL.
dave_cust: Pasting rawbody:```json
{
  "id": "r-abc",
  "object": "response",
  "choices": [{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"I can help cancel that. What is the order ID?"}}]
}```

carla_sre: Not seeing 5xx or LB errors from the frontends. Deploy-bot shows rollout id `rollout-2026-03-14-0955`.
bob_eng: That response looks like the model didn't emit a toolcall object. Two hypotheses: (1) model variant changed canonical vs tool-call behavior, (2) the tool-mapping layer dropped the call.
alice_support: Customer is blocked. Any ETA on investigator? :bug:
bob_eng: I'm pulling traces. @carla_sre can you check the fnbridge logs for skipped invocations for session s-6789 around 09:10?
carla_sre: Checking... grep shows an entry `skip_invoke: true` for that session, reason `schema_mismatch` at 09:11:03 UTC. Sending log snippet:```
[09:11:03] session=s-6789 skip_invoke=true reason=schema_mismatch details="arg order_id missing (expected string)"
```

alice_support: Hmm customer says they passed order_id as a string. Maybe serialization changed.
dave_cust: We saw order_id as integer in our logs for one request: `12345` (no quotes) — our client used typed JSON. Not sure why. We always sent string before.
bob_eng: Ok that's useful. We recently shipped a JSON canonicalizer in the mapper that enforces field types for tool args. The canary should have validated against tool schema and coerced ints->strings, but looks like coercion was disabled in the rollout config. I'll check the PR (git#4567).
carla_sre: We can patch the mapper to accept numeric order_id and coerce to string as a hotfix. Should we rollback the rollout to restore previous behavior?
bob_eng: Hotfix first to mapper to be quick. If wider impact, we'll rollback.
alice_support: Customer prefers immediate workaround. Dave, can you coerce order_id to string on your client as temporary mitigation?
dave_cust: Can do, we'll push a quick client patch now. What's the long-term fix?
bob_eng: We'll add tolerant parsing + a regression test ensuring toolcall args survive rollout. Also add an e2e that exercises int->string coercion for order_cancel.
carla_sre: Filed internal incident INC-2306 and linked deploy rollback plan. If mapper patch doesn't land in 45m, we'll flip traffic to previous variant.
alice_support: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer thread with proposed client patch and ETA. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout `rollout-2026-03-14-0955` -> new mapper image `redwood/mapper:v3.2.1` staged at 08:55 UTC.
bob_eng: PR #4567 had a config flag `strict_schema_parsing: true` accidentally enabled for prod canary. I reverted the flag in a hotfix branch, running tests now.
carla_sre: Hotfix deployed to mapper-canary at 09:48 UTC. Observability shows toolcalls for sample sessions succeed. Will promote to prod in 10m if green.
alice_support: Customer confirmed client patch worked and received function call again. They'll hold off bigger changes until prod fix. Closing when prod promoted.
dave_cust: Confirmed, our client patch fixed the immediate issue. Thanks for quick turnaround.
alice_support: Marking follow-ups: (1) regression test for arg coercion, (2) telemetry alert on skip_invoke rate, (3) postmortem on config gating.
bob_eng: Adding test to CI and creating eval prompt set to catch similar toolcall regressions.
carla_sre: Will keep monitoring for 2h, will rollback if errors spike.
alice_support: Closing the support thread, internal incident continues. :lock:
